name: Top Stocks
description: Widely held, large-capitalization companies that make up the core of many diversified portfolios.

name: Trending Stocks
description: Companies generating outsized investor attention and trading volume.

name: Dividend Stocks
description: Companies with a track record of returning cash to shareholders through regular dividend payments.

name: AI Stocks
description: Companies building or heavily monetizing artificial intelligence infrastructure and applications.

name: Technology Stocks
description: Companies in software, hardware, semiconductors, and internet services.

name: Banking Stocks
description: Commercial and investment banks, insurers, and other financial institutions.

name: Energy Stocks
description: Oil, gas, and utility companies tied to global energy production and consumption.

name: Healthcare Stocks
description: Pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, and health services companies.

name: EV Stocks
description: Electric vehicle manufacturers and the supply chains that support them.

name: Semiconductor Stocks
description: Chipmakers and the equipment and design companies behind the global semiconductor supply chain.

name: High Growth Stocks
description: Companies prioritizing rapid revenue expansion, often reinvesting earnings rather than paying dividends.
